Made Just For You

Custom Orders

Some of our favorite work starts as a sketch on a napkin. A board sized for a specific drawer, a matched set for a restaurant line, an anniversary gift with a date carved underneath — if it's wood and it belongs in a kitchen, we can probably build it.

How It Works

From idea to doorstep

No surprises. We agree on the details and price before a single board is cut.

Tell us the idea

Send dimensions, wood preferences, intended use, and any engraving. Photos of your space or inspiration are welcome. We'll ask questions to fill in the gaps.

We quote & sketch

Within a few days you'll get a firm price, a wood plan, and a rough sketch or reference. A 50% deposit reserves your spot on the bench.

We build & ship

Most custom pieces take 3–5 weeks depending on the queue. We send progress photos, collect the balance, and ship it carefully boxed — or set up local pickup.

Good To Know

The fine print

Pricing Custom work generally runs from $90 for small single boards to $400+ for large island blocks or matched sets. Engraving adds $15–$40. You'll always get a firm quote first.
Deposit & timing A 50% deposit books your spot. Typical lead time is 3–5 weeks. Need it by a date? Tell us up front and we'll be honest about whether we can hit it.
Shipping & pickup We ship UPS Ground within the US, carefully boxed. Local pickup in Bellingham is free by appointment. We don't ship internationally yet — email us and we'll figure something out.
